title: Token Resolution, Material, Frame & Ornament Runtime
objective: Implement the bounded UISK presentation-engine layer for token resolution, material/surface recipes, frame/border/ornament composition, cost/degradation metadata and safe fallbacks over the UISR-01 registry foundation.

included: T0-T6 token resolution and protected semantic precedence
material/surface recipe runtime with opaque/reduced fallbacks and cost classes
frame/border/ornament composition primitives and deterministic joins
safe common fallback when optional presentation recipes/assets are absent
focused UISR-02 tests and cross-platform exact-head validation
excluded: typography/font asset and reading-assistance runtime reserved for UISR-03
motion/effects/shared component recipe runtime reserved for UISR-04
Skin Laboratory and specialized-surface bindings reserved for UISR-05
gallery/persistence and full target skin materialization
gameplay, permission, hidden-information, routing, validation or provenance authority
scope.completion_gate: The shared UI runtime can deterministically resolve the UISK token/material/frame/ornament layers with protected semantics and fallback/degradation behavior, without requiring feature-component forks or changing application authority.

selection_boundaries: UISR-02 is selected by successful UISR-01 closeout but has no implementation authority until owner Continue.
The ui-implementation lane remains parallel to product-development and may not pause or rewrite MCS work.
Publication to Multiversal-app main remains serialized by the existing merge lease and requires fresh-base reconciliation if another lane publishes first.
next_action: Await owner Continue. On Continue, fresh-read OPS3, govern-start UISR-02 on a dedicated UI branch from then-current application main, and execute only the bounded UISR-02 tranche.
